rules.statement: A purchaser in execution of a decree in an action on the bond can maintain an action in the nature of an actio doli against the parties involved to obtain a cancellation of the conveyance.
rules.supporting_quote: Held, that it was competent to a purchaser in execution of a decree in an action on the bond in favour of C to maintain an action in the nature of an actio doli against A, B, and A's children to obtain a cancellation of the conveyance in favour of B and A's children.

meta.parties: Usubu Lebbe v. Gabriel Et Al
